tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dngul gyi gter kha brtag pa sogs lung bstan gyi skor bzhugs so//

rdo kha kha gnyis kyi dngul rdo so sor bskyal byung yang brtag pa phyogs gcig tu byas chog pa 'dug pa ni/ de yi don nyab nyob mang bar 'dug kyang mdor bsdus nas tshigs su bcad pa ni/ dngul lung rdo kha'i rin chen gter// dus deng sang bzang bzang 'dra mod kyang*// lar 'gag pa'i rgyu mtshan mang du gda'// sa 'dir nas gzhal ba'i nub kyi phyogs// dgon khra mo gcig nas 'ongs zer ba'i// 'dre rgyal 'gong zhig kyang slebs zin pa// da zhag grangs bcu tsam ma song bar// khong bande'i rjes la 'ong ba 'dra// de yin min kun gyi thugs la gsal// khong 'gro 'dod mi gda' sdod 'dod gda'// yang dam nyams tshogs pa'i ded dpon zhig /mi sha tsa sngo la lus sbom zhing*// tshig sna tshogs yod pa cho le smra// de'i dngul rdo dgag pa ma shes sam// dngul 'gag pa ma tshad dmyal bar 'khrid// de spangs thabs yod na dga' ba la// dus ngan pa'i sems can las re ngan| |skyabs dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rjes gzigs// sa spo bo lung gi gzhi bdag tsho// lus khrab dkar zha nyes byas pa de// 'phral legs legs 'dra yang ci 'dra'am// dgrar rgyal 'gong langs na nyams re mtshar// gyod rang gi nyos pa'i dngul dkar de// yun ring na lcags kyi gong bur 'gro// de 'gro'am mi 'gro shes nas 'ong*// sa g.yu sgong lung pa'i lha btsan tsho// rgyu dngul las byas pa'i sha gdan khyer// dus deng sang ri klung kun la rgyug /de bzhag na deng sang chog chog 'dra// yun ring na 'gyod pa zhig mi 'ong ngam// sa dngul lung mdo pa'i gzhi bdag tsho// khab rtse lnga khyer nas kun tu rgyug /des ci byed dris pas tshem bu byed// a mtshar ba rtse lnga'i tshem bu de// sngar ma go 'on kyang mi min pa'i// khyod lha 'dre'i tshem bur srid do snyam/ /de 'dra ba'i mtshar mtshar mang po zhig /mi bdag la yod kyang re zhig 'then| |da dngul kha'i rim gro 'di ltar mdzod// yum rgyas 'bring rnam gsum ci mang thon// da rdo kha'i lha 'dre mchod pas brngan// yul 'di tsho'i yi dwags la chu gtor mdzod| /|dngul gcod pa'i dngul kha'i rgyal 'gong de// 'phral rtsub 'gyur che la gting ring bas// de yas kyis legs par brngan byas nas/

/sngar 'dug sa'i sa der skyol la thongs| |yongs de ltar byas na rdo kha der// dngul cung zad 'byung ngam the tshom mam// de rdo kha gnyis kyi brtag pa mdzod/ /dge'o// // ༈ /lha dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas// mi kho bo'i sbyin bdag dad stobs can// khyod tshe ring rgyal pos slar dris pa'i// nyams mtshar ba'i skad cha 'di 'dra bdog /dbus nyi 'og nas 'phang pa'i mda' mo de// shar rgya nag yul du thal gyis song*// mda' 'phang dus nyag phran smyug la byas// mda' bab tshe gor ma'i rdo la song*// lha rigs gsum mgon po bzhad re bro| |smad mdo khams sgang gi nags ri'i dbus// shing tsha la rtsub pa'i ljon pa de// 'phral lo 'dab 'bras bu rgyas 'dug kyang*// khyod rtsa ba me yis tshig nas gda'// shing 'gyel nas dum bur 'gro'am snyam// sa yo ba dar gsum gzhi bdag tsho// khyod la la glo ba'i zhwa mo gyon// de phud na drag gam gyon na drag /yang la la phub ma'i dga' ston 'gyed// de su la byin yang 'dod 'dod 'dra// yang ri rgyud brag la thug pa'i 'gram// shing ljon pa'i logs kyi bya tshang de// sbrul khra bos gtor nyan mi 'dug gam// zon thugs tsag mdzad na e drag gam| |'og rgya mtsho khol ba'i rlangs pa de// deng nam mkha'i mthongs su yang yang song*// de smin pa chu 'dzin phung po 'khrigs// yongs de las char zhig 'bab 'bab 'dra// de chu khrag rnag tu 'bab mi 'bab// lha kong btsun de mos bsam mno thongs// kong btsun de mo'i chang mgron de// sde mi mang la byed dam mi byed ltos/ /sa mdo khams lung gi lha mi tsho| |dbyings nam mkha'i mthongs su 'brug sgra sgrog /chu 'dzin gyi phung po lang long 'khrigs// 'brug skad de rgya nag rgyal pos tshor// glog dmar de rgya gar rgyal pos mthong*/ /de char du 'bab bam ser ba 'bab// rlung bsil bu zhig gi las su gda'// sa g.yu sgang lung pa'i lha 'dre tsho/

/rdo dngul dkar gyi las 'di bzang lags kyang*// rdo khab tu bzhu ba'i khu ba la// zhun khu dang khrag khu nor dogs che// de nor na khyod cag ci drag ang*// rdo zhu na khrag tu 'bab srid kyang*/ /de dngul du bsgyur ba'i thabs rtsol zhig /yod srid kyang kun gyis shes par dka'// dgon khra mor sbas pa'i sol dong de// dus deng sang 'don 'dod 'dra la sbed// de thon na rang gzhan kun la gnod// 'dre rgyal 'gong bshos pa'i phru gu la// bya khwa ta mang po byung ba de// dus deng sang ag sgras stong khams khyab// de gshog drug rgyas na nyams re mtshar// sa rung sgo zer ba'i ri brag po// gos phyed phyed gyon la phyed phyed phud// de gyon phud da dung tshod ma thig /gos gyon na dbyar dus tshad pa tsha// gos phud na dgun ka grang gis dogs// de the tshom gyi ngang la skal ba 'jigs// lha shākya thub pa'i rjes 'jug tsho// chos tshul bzhin byas na nyes dmigs chung*// yongs dmyal khams kyi zangs gzhung dmar po de// me tsha mor 'dug pa ma gzigs sam// der 'gyod kyang cung zad phyis pa 'dra// de gzhan skyon min mod rang skyon yin// slar 'gyod na rang byas zas su zo// lar 'jig rten srid pa'i 'dam gyi dbus// mi la la mtshar la 'ga' tsam sdug /de res mos lags pa mkhyen lags sam// brag zangs thang dmar po'i rtse mo nas// slar sprin dmar 'khrigs pa'i rdul zhig ldang*// sprin sne mo dar rtse mdo ru thal// lha gnam lha byang chub bzhad re bro// dbus zangs thang rgyal po'i shel mig gis// khams lha mo rtse yi mched brgyad po// grogs bag mar blangs pa'i dga' ston de// mtshon rno ngar ldan pa mang pos byas| |lar khrag ru byug pa ma mthong ngam// sa dar rtse mdo pa'i lha 'dre tsho// sems gdug rtsub bzhag nas phan sems bskyed// gangs nam mkha'i mthongs su snyegs 'dra de// sang chab tu 'gro 'dug mi shes sam// sa mdo gsum 'dus pa'i tshong dus der// dus deng sang mkho dgu 'dzoms 'dug kyang*// bran khra mos byin pa'i khrag tshod de// khyed kun gyi khog par song 'dug gi// de skyug par byas kyang thon par dka'// sman mdzes ma'i bza' btung zhim po de// dug ha las sbags 'dug yi re mug

/de shes na da lta 'jog tshod tsam// yun ring na nad kyang 'gram gyi dogs// sa 'dod dgu 'dzoms pa'i bod 'bangs rnams// dus deng sang longs spyod khrag la byed// de res mos shig 'khor na gang du 'ong*// lha shel ging dkar po'i ber thul gyis// mtho nam mkha' khebs kyang la la mthong*// de gyon phud byed dam mi byed la// de deng sang the tshom ngang du gda'// dbus gtsang gi sha pho ru bcu la// mdo khams kyi 'brong g.yag be ser byung*// slar khyi phag tu 'gro 'dug nyams re mtshar// sa stod du shar ba'i khri gdugs 'di/ /dro 'jam nyi ma zhig re na yang*/ /phan med kyi nyi ma nag chen 'dra| |'di skyo na nyag phran grogs po mkho// rgyu g.yu las grub pa'i lcags sgrog dang*// gser gar blugs kyi bum pa legs po 'dug /de legs legs 'dra yang e rtag gam// rgyu dngul las byas pa'i me long de// bzhin gsal por mthong 'dug bltas drags na// de dum bur chag pa ma nges sam// dus deng sang byu ru'i thor cog la| |tshe nam zhig gser gyi thod ldan 'byung*// de byung na legs snyam mi sems kyang*/ /mi kho bo 'dod pa'i bro zhig brdung*// lha gnyan chen thang lha'i sol khur de// khams stong tshal sgang du phos nas thal// de mgar bas thob na dga' mod kyang*// mgron lam zhug rnams la byed rgyu chung*// sa 'di nas gzhal ba'i nub phyogs der// rgyu skar gyi 'od lam thal bas byas// bya byi'u ltar nyal ba'i gshog drug gis// phyogs mu med khyab 'dug ma mthong ngam// sa rgya bod kyi khra mo mdzes ma de// mdzes tshul gyi spyod pa bzang por snang*// slar bzang yun ring na dga' ba la// rgyu shing las byas pa'i sil snyan de// skad la las tshor la 'gas mi tshor// de tshor na dga' 'am ci zhig bgyid// shar phyogs nam mkha'i sprin lam dkar po de| |lho byang rlung gi rgyu bas ma bkag na// nub rlung brag ri'i ngos la gzhol le 'dra// gnod sbyin thugs kyis 'od stong drangs pa 'di// rang rang blo la phan nam mi phan ltos// kong btsun de mo'i bro ra der// dung thod can gyis bro dpon byed// bro glu mdo khams sgang nas len// bro ston dar rtse mdo ru byed// ltad mo dbus gtsang lung pas lta// de tsam skad cha'i gnas tshul mdzod// lo mang po zhig gi gnas tshul yod// lcags bya phan gyi skad cha 'di// don rim gyis smin tshe ser gyis gnon// 'di e bden gzhon rim tshe ring na// don thams cad gser gyis khyab nas 'ong*// de gnas po'i sku ngo mi bcag phyir// lha shākya thub pa'i 'dul khrims de// don nyams med srung ba'i dge slong zhig

/ming smos na chos kyi grags pas sbyar| |dge bar gyur cig /yang snag shog 'dzoms pa'i lag dal 'di// dus ma 'ongs pa na nyams mtshar rgyu// rgyu lung pa'i dgon pa khra mo der// dro 'jam gyi nyi ma 'char dus med| |rgyu dngul la byas pa'i ser gzugs can// dus nam zhig skyo grogs khyi la re/ /snying dum bur 'thor ba'i a ma la/ /'dre bse rag gi phru gu skye la khad/ /de kun dga' gzhon nus ma mthong ngam// gangs dkar po'i pho brang mdzes pa de// dus nam zhig 'brong g.yag 'khor ba'i gnas// brag bya pho'i rgya zor 'dra ba'i sne'i// rdzong khra mo'i nang gi skya ser tsho// the tshom gyi nam la langs dus med// 'bri rwa med kyi skyu ra'i dbon po tsho// gzhu chang bzung la sbyar ba'i nyag phran de// rang bsam bsam gyi mtheb stong sprad nas gda'// mda' rdeg pa 'ben la rdeg 'dod kyang*// blo gnyis 'dzin kyi ngang du brdal brdal 'dra// yun ring na mchog dkar khyi la 'gel// sa gzhi med kyi ban sdom 'tshogs pa de// dus da lta brod pa'i dga' bro rdung*// gur dkar mo'i steng na 'dre bya bab// de skan sgra rdeb cing mchu sder bdar// byang phyogs nas 'ongs pa ma yin nam// de rang byas yin mod skyo ba la// yang skyo na shar du bya zhig skyol// dbus gtsang gi dge 'dun bshes mkhas tsho// dus re zhig ka kha'i slob gnyer mdzad// de sngon nas sbyang na dga' ba la// dus deng sang ka kha'i skyo ba la// yang thub bstan bgres po'i zhabs 'bring can// mi pags las byas pa'i phad bu de// nang thal bas brdzangs kyang gser du song*// smad mdo khams su spungs pa'i phub ma de// dus deng sang gangs dkar rtse ru rgyas// dgon khams pa'i bya tshang legs po de// dus deng sang bya phran gyis gang nas gda'// bya gshog drug mtha' nas rgyas pa'i tshe| |mtho nam 'phang gcod na e mtshar ang*// yul mdo khams kyi bde mo'i thang chen la// bang mgyogs pa mang po rgyug 'dod byed// de brgyug na mgyogs pa'i rkang rtsal las| |lus rkang pa zha ba de mi mgyogs sam// tsha ba sgang gi ltad mo la// mig hrig hrig mang pos ltad mo byed// yang bltas na mthong ba'i nges pa ci// mig long ba zhig gis mthong nas 'ong*// skyu ra'i dge bshes btsun btsun tsho// thug sdor de glo bas byas pa 'dra// 'bri bse ru gung ston bong bu zhon// gnas bla g.yel thang la rgyug pa mthong*// de brtag na gzhu lung phu mda' tsho// der ma zad de la gtogs pa kun// thugs dgyes par mdzod cig dgongs lags sam// rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po khyod// mtshon ngar ma'i rma la brtag dpyad mdzod// mtshon phog pa'i khrag rul khong du 'khyil// rme khrag de gsol na nad kyis 'chi// khyod mdzad pa dka' yang 'di kho na// rgyu gser gyi rdor dril cha gcig de// 'dre the'u rang gi 'ur rdo byas pa snyam// de khang thog tu bab na skyon med kyang*// sa thal dong du lhung na nye ba 'dra// lha 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po khyod// mi kho bo'i zhwa mo gser la byas// mi la las zhwa mo sgom zhu gyon// de khyod la phyogs 'dzin yod mi snyam/

/don des na de yang khyod kyis shes// rgyu gos dar la byas pa'i dge bshes tsho// dus da lta 'gyod pa'i sgang du gda'// mgo drim drim 'dra yang 'khor nas gda'// 'di mus kyi lab lob mang 'dug kyang*// rgyu shog bu 'dzad pas ran tshod bzung*// mi kho bo'i gsar dran min mod kyi// don gshis la 'dug pa smras pa yin// don de dag skyu ra'i sdom bu ba// zas dkor gyis myos pas 'chol gtam byas// gtam bden no la la rdzun gtam 'dra// gtam rdzun rdzun la la bden pa 'dra// de deng sang ni 'bri lung skyog mor thal// shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ g.yu ri ba dang chu mdo 'dus 'khrug gi brtag pa la/ lar mdo khams kyi ser ba mu khrid de// zhing 'bras drug 'dzoms 'dod re ba la// 'brug 'ur sgra che la 'bab don med// 'bras drug sad kyis khyer ba la// ser ba bab kyang dgos pa chung*// stag khra bo'i mig nas khrag chu 'bab| |spang mthon po'i sha ba smug po yi// rwa bcu ri bong mgo la bzhag /lar gzugs las rwa co che ba de// 'phral 'jigs 'jigs 'dra yang nyams re mtshar// ri bong khung du 'dzul dus rwa co thar ba gshis kyi dka' mor gda' lags/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// mi bdag la spyan lnga ldan pa yi// chos lkog gyur shes pa'i mngon shes dang*| |lha bla ma'i lung bstan mi bdog kyang*// gshis rang bzhin shes pa'i gnas tshul tsam// khyod blo gros rgyal po nan ches pas// tshig gsong por smras 'di dgongs bzhugs 'tshal| |sa mdo khams stod kyi chos ra nang*// ban ser po'i chos gos bya khyis zos// chos dkar po zer yang nag por 'gro// lha bla ma'i phyag rjes mtshar po gda'// phar sribs kyi gor ma rdo ba la// sa gtsang mar bcos pa'i zan dron byung*// de e gcun mgur lha gnyan la dris// rgan skya bo'i lag tu ber ka gtad// de gnam du 'phang na ser ba 'bab// sa mdo khams kyi 'bras drug 'joms 'dod zer// mi skya ser 'ga' yi mgo bo la// zhwa khra mo gyon nas 'o dod 'bod// shar mdzes ma'i kha nas khrag ngan skyug

/khrag sa la bo tshe bya khyis zos| |mdo khams kyi bya rgyal rgod po la// nam zhig pha wang mang po byung*// sa mdo shar lung pa'i khri gdugs kyis// dus nam zhig zla ba grogs su zos// khyad khyi la bor ba'i snying med po// dus ring po zhig nas 'gyod pa skyes// don mngar ba'i ro la dug chu 'dres// pha ma med pa'i bu mo la// a pha med pa'i phru gu skyes// rgad por longs nas g.yag la zhon// g.yag rgod kha rlangs me bas tsha// sa mdo khams lung pa'i phu chu de/ /dus nam zhig rgya mtshor 'dre'am snyam// mtsho rlabs dang ldan pa'i rba klong gis| |bya khwa ta mang po tshang la snyegs// ri chen po'i mgo nas me chen 'bar// 'og dma' mo'i rgya mtsho khad kyis skam// de rang bzhin bltas na nyams re mtshar// za mo rtswa lo'i rtsa ba la| |rtswa ser po skyes pa'i ltad mo ltos// smyug drang por btab pa'i sa bon la// 'bras grung mor skyes na nyams mtshar byed// don de dag gnas tshul tho tsam yin// maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ /skyabs dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// sa mnga' ris stod du spu ris mang*// spu ris mi gcig rta dang g.yag /smyug drang por skyes pa'i mda' mo dang*// sum khugs su 'khyogs pa'i gzhu mo gnyis// drang 'khyogs lang tsho mi gcig kyang*// mnyam por sdebs pa chos nyid yin// khong rta g.yag la sngar 'dris med na yang*// dus deng sang mi mdza' ba'i dpe ru byed// rwa co can gyi rdung kha dang*// gyi ling gi 'phra kha gang rgyal bar// gangs dkar rtse ru rgyas pa la// khri gdugs nyi ma'i tsha gdung las// skyi ser rlung po mi gzan nam| |nyang khams lung pa'i tshong 'dus na// gre mo 'dre gdug gi pad kor snang*// glu snyan por blang pa cho nger song*// ban chos pa'i snyan la skyon med kyang*// de stag shar dra ma'i thugs la gzan// mkhar skyid por bcos pa'i re'u mig de// mi chen po'i rigs kyi dur khrod yin// rus ka kha wa za'i skye bo rnams// chos mi rtag 'dus byas sgom mi dgos// de mngon sum mthong ba'i ltad mo 'byung*// gangs ti se'i lha chen dpal 'bar la// nub stag shar mang po'i mda' kha las// shar bande'i phur 'cham tshe la gzan// de bzlog thabs gda' ste shes par dka'// tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nya gang la// shar chu 'dzin stug po'i sgrib g.yogs dang*// nub sgra gcan kha yi rlangs pa las// byang brag dmar logs kyi 'ug pa de'i| |skad gad mor sgrog pa ya re cha// dgung khri gdugs nub rir chas nye na// sprin med kyi zla ba 'char la nye// de mtshan mo rgyu skar gyis bskor ba'i tshe// mtho nam mkha' nas kyang rang skad sgrog

/sa thal skya khad kyis yangs pa'i lho// grong mang pos bskor ba'i dkyil stod na// mkhar dkar po'i nang gi gzhon pa de'i// g.yos dug du bsnyal la langs su che// de zos pa'i mi rnams ma shi bar// byan mo shi ba'i ro zhig 'byung*// zas zos pas grod pa 'grang dus med// bza' med kyi ltog pa skyug snyam byed// don de tsho blo gros can gyis shes// mi bdag la mngon shes med na yang*// khyed mnga' bdag karma phrin las kyis// don dris pas lha dang bla ma la// yid dad pas gsol btab lung bstan bzhin| |slar yi ger bris pa 'di rnams kyang*// tshig nag por smras pa'i don gsal po// lo 'ga' zhig khongs su yid ches 'byung*// zhes pa 'di yang mnga' ris rgyal sras mnga' bdag karma phrin las kyis dris pa'i lan 'ga' zhig la/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas me glang zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la dpal 'bri gung gi gdan sa chen por bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ lha dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas| |gnas smyug ma'i nags khrod tshang tshing na// lha gsal rig mngon shes ldan pa na// dbyings stong pa'i mdzes mas 'khyud 'khyud nas// don sna tshogs dris la 'di skad ces| |khong khyo shug gsang gtam bdag gis thos// dbus nyi 'og nas 'phur ba'i 'dab chags shig /shar khri gdugs 'og tu thal gyis song*// de 'dab ma ma phog 'tshams srid nas| |lo 'ga' nas 'dab chags ci 'dra 'byung*// lha rwa mgo rwa co'i bcos pa des// ja zhim du 'thung ba'i ra bzi la// gnas gangs dkar lha mo bred nas song*// shar tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i yul gru nas// skad sna tshogs bsgyur ba'i gar mkhan mang*// gar lang ling rtsed na ltad mo che// dbus khri gdugs nyi ma'i pho brang na// lha btsan po'i gros ra khyi yis gang*| |khyi phyogs bcur zug kyang su mi 'jigs// lho rgya stag dom dang 'phar spyang bzhi// brag stong pa'i phug par 'tshogs 'tshogs nas// shing 'bras bu can gyi dga' ston la// dus da lta rtse ba'i gar la rol// brag gnam lcags thog gis 'jig 'jig 'dra// nub sna tshogs spyod pa'i ya ma brla// bya 'dab ma mang po'i kha dog la/

/tshon ma byug rang gar grub pa de| |dus myur du mthong ba'i mtshan ma yod// byang 'jag ma'i tshal gyi ri dwags la// nad khong nas 'khrugs pa'i zug rngu yi// skad sna tshogs sgrog nas phyogs bcur byes// de ri dwags yongs kyi nyams mtshar gnas// sa dmar la yangs pa'i do ra der// las mang po mkhan gyi do ra byed// g.yas pad kor gar stabs dang re spro// lha sna tshogs ngu zhing cho nge sgrog /bro shon la bltas pa'i cho nge dang*// brang rdung gi sa gzhi e ma gang*// ri seṅge nyal 'dra'i rin chen rgyan// bzo sna tshogs bcos pa'i rtsed 'jo la// don sha khrag rus pa'i gan mdzod byed// 'dre sha za yi dwags nang nas langs// de gshed ma'i tshogs kyi gtso bor snang*// snying dmar po'i rtse mo me lce 'bar// me stag steng dang shar du 'gro| |de shing dang rtswa la me 'bar gyi// sa rdo rnams la me de mched// de mched pa'i me de 'bab chur song*// chu mthur du ma bab gyen tu 'phyur// de khol ba'i lbu ba dbus gtsang du| |chad chod du sleb na dang re spro// gnas bzang du re ba'i skyid zhag la// mtshon 'bar ba'i gar gyis bsnun bsnun nas// sems skyid skyid 'dra bar bsad pa'i don// lha gnam thel pe har bzhad pa 'di// mi kun gyis mthong na e ma mtshar// lug spyang ki mi mthun tshang gcig tu// sems ma 'dres bzhin du nyal ba'i rtsar// nags rgya stag khra bo gsod sar sleb| |de mthong yang ma mthong rdzu bag de// don shes na rang mgo rang skor yin// lus padma 'dra ba'i ge sar na// chu bskol phyir me la sbud pa phu// me 'bar bas chu khol lud pa na| |slad me rang gsod pa ltad mo che// spang khra mo'i ldebs la sha mong mang*// de grod pa ltog pa'i kha zas byed// nang 'bu yis khengs kyang za ba mthong*// sa khad kyis mtho ba'i rtse mo na| |mi sna tshogs 'dus pa'i byan mo yis// zas sman du bsnyal ba'i dug can du// dus mi 'gyang lang na kun gyis za// zas dug dang 'dres pas la la shi// la la na yang la la skyug

|mi dkar po gsum gyis de ma zos// de ma zos bzhin du skyug log nas// dus deng sang hag sgra hog sgra sgrog /mgo mdung las ring ba'i smyung smyung de// rlung che na 'khyag pa'i nyin gcig snang*// rgyu gser las byas pa'i thong bshol de// rin thang che yang sa mi phed// mi phed bzhin du rmo ba yin// mthong mkhan klad med cig de na gda'// gcig mi tshad gnyis dang gsum na'ang 'dug /zhing rmos kyang sa
